headline: Shoulder-high prime SE swell groomed by strong cross-off — the drive pays today.
today: Best of the East End today: prime SE angle pushing well overhead-of-nothing but a legit 4ft-plus faces, and that 18mph NNE cross-off holds it up and cleans the walls. Period is short so expect it a touch quick and stacked, but it's got size and a good angle, which is rare. Shortboard or fish, and don't sleep on the morning before the wind eases off. Worth the 2.5hr if today's the day you can go.

daysToWatch.note: Prime SSE angle to 3ft, but W cross winds 14-17mph will chop it up. Fun if you catch a lull, not a green-light drive.
Mixed SSE with a long-period line buried in there early under cross-off wind — worth a look at dawn, deteriorates to onshore by afternoon.
